description: Retries with exponential backoff plus random jitter to avoid thundering herd. Mirrors engine/runtime/retry.py::JitteredBackoffRetryStrategy.
instructions: Calculate delay as exponential backoff, then add random jitter within +-jitter_fraction range (default 0.25).
Example: base delay 4s, jitter fraction 0.25 => delay between 3s and 5s.
Useful when multiple tasks may fail simultaneously and retry in lockstep.
